title: Actions not requiring special review

blocks.html: The special review requirements of Section 105-40 (SPECIAL REVIEW PROVISIONS) of this Chapter shall not apply to the following:
blocks.plainText: The special review requirements of Section 105-40 (SPECIAL REVIEW PROVISIONS) of this Chapter shall not apply to the following:

blocks.html: (a)        a site alteration on a zoning lot containing buildings or other structures, or a development or enlargement on any zoning lot, provided that such zoning lots shall have:
blocks.plainText: (a) a site alteration on a zoning lot containing buildings or other structures, or a development or enlargement on any zoning lot, provided that such zoning lots shall have:

blocks.html: (1)        not more than 10,000 square feet of lot area;
blocks.plainText: (1) not more than 10,000 square feet of lot area;

blocks.html: (2)        an average percent of slope of less than 10 percent;
blocks.plainText: (2) an average percent of slope of less than 10 percent;

blocks.html: (3)        no significant natural features, and the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration can satisfy the requirements of Section 105-30 (PRESERVATION OF NATURAL FEATURES), inclusive;
blocks.plainText: (3) no significant natural features, and the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration can satisfy the requirements of Section 105-30 (PRESERVATION OF NATURAL FEATURES), inclusive;

blocks.html: (4)        the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration not exceed 2,500 square feet of lot coverage; and
blocks.plainText: (4) the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration not exceed 2,500 square feet of lot coverage; and

blocks.html: (5)        no Notice of Restriction or Restrictive Declaration recorded against the title of such property;
blocks.plainText: (5) no Notice of Restriction or Restrictive Declaration recorded against the title of such property;

blocks.html: (b)        any site alteration, on a zoning lot containing a residential building in existence on the effective date of the Special District designation, involving a structure that does not require a permit from the Department of Buildings, including, but not limited to swimming pools, garden sheds and fences, provided that:
blocks.plainText: (b) any site alteration, on a zoning lot containing a residential building in existence on the effective date of the Special District designation, involving a structure that does not require a permit from the Department of Buildings, including, but not limited to swimming pools, garden sheds and fences, provided that:

blocks.html: (1)        any modification of topography for the footprint, foundation or grading around the footprint of such structure shall not exceed two feet of cut or fill; and
blocks.plainText: (1) any modification of topography for the footprint, foundation or grading around the footprint of such structure shall not exceed two feet of cut or fill; and

blocks.html: (2)        no tree of six-inch caliper or greater shall be removed and the critical root zone of such tree shall be an area of no disturbance on any zoning lot.
blocks.plainText: (2) no tree of six-inch caliper or greater shall be removed and the critical root zone of such tree shall be an area of no disturbance on any zoning lot.

subsections.label: (a)
subsections.plainText: (a) a site alteration on a zoning lot containing buildings or other structures, or a development or enlargement on any zoning lot, provided that such zoning lots shall have:
(1) not more than 10,000 square feet of lot area;
(2) an average percent of slope of less than 10 percent;
(3) no significant natural features, and the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration can satisfy the requirements of Section 105-30 (PRESERVATION OF NATURAL FEATURES), inclusive;
(4) the resulting development, enlargement or site alteration not exceed 2,500 square feet of lot coverage; and
(5) no Notice of Restriction or Restrictive Declaration recorded against the title of such property;

subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) any site alteration, on a zoning lot containing a residential building in existence on the effective date of the Special District designation, involving a structure that does not require a permit from the Department of Buildings, including, but not limited to swimming pools, garden sheds and fences, provided that:
(1) any modification of topography for the footprint, foundation or grading around the footprint of such structure shall not exceed two feet of cut or fill; and
(2) no tree of six-inch caliper or greater shall be removed and the critical root zone of such tree shall be an area of no disturbance on any zoning lot.
